input: Any commit that modifies /moves/bishop_f8.text or /moves/knight_g8.text, the two agents that keep going off plan, must be co-signed by at least fifteen of the sixteen Black agents' keys in addition to the moving piece's own key, and must also modify /turn/ply.num.
response: always([+modifies(/moves/bishop_f8.text) -modifies(/turn/ply.num)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/bishop_f8.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/bishop_f8.id)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/bishop_f8.text) -threshold("15", /team/pieces)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/knight_g8.text) -modifies(/turn/ply.num)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/knight_g8.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/knight_g8.id)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/knight_g8.text) -threshold("15", /team/pieces)] false)
